name: Do I need to clear the room before ceiling repair begins?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to clear the room before ceiling repair begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is highly recommended to clear the room of furniture, electronics, and personal belongings before ceiling repair begins. This protects your items from dust and debris and provides our team with a clear workspace, allowing for a more efficient and safer repair process. If moving large items is challenging, please inform us, and we can discuss potential solutions during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, clear the room of furniture and personal items to protect them from dust and provide a clear, safe workspace for the repair team.
